item.title: DUENCH: A golden moment for U.S. men's hockey, diminished by laughter and misplaced priorities
item.description: An overtime gold should have been a unifying moment for a sport experiencing a cultural surge, yet the celebrations shifted the focus from the ice to hockey’s long-standing monoculture.
